description:
FILED s520a (Opus 5.5, 2026-10-18) while probing #3413's filename builtins with a handle.  SILENT WRONG (pre-existing: the fca3593b base answers the same).

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3):
    my $d = "/tmp/u-$$"; mkdir $d; open my $fh, '>', "$d/a" or die;
    print utime(10, 20, $fh), " ", (stat "$d/a")[9], "\n";
perl: `1 20` (utime on a FILEHANDLE is futimes(2) on its descriptor).  PCL: `0 <now>` -- p-utime passes every LIST element to utime(2) as a PATH, so the handle stringifies to a nonexistent name and nothing is touched.
FIX DIRECTION: p-utime's loop takes a handle-shaped element (the p-chmod / p-chown `streamp` arm) through futimes on the fd; sb-posix has no futimes (MEMORY: "stat-blksize/blocks/futimes ABSENT"), so it is an sb-alien call to futimens / futimes, or utimensat with the fd.  A platform-touching change: the install matrix + the macOS leg.

=== s543c (Opus 5.5, 2026-11-21, CODE 64353611) ===
VERDICT: LIVE -- as filed (silent): `print utime(10, 20, $fh), " ", (stat "$d/a")[9]` perl `1 20`, PCL `0 <now>`; the path spelling
  `utime(30, 40, "$d/a")` -> 1 40 in both.
LABEL: silent (subject now says so).

=== DONE (s543n, Opus 5.5, 2026-11-24; WIP 9 3f690293) -- the remembered-path route; the rest documented ===
%p-utime-target: a lexical / glob / glob-ref element of utime's list is a HANDLE (perl's MAYBE_DEREF_GV; a bareword
NAME stays a path).  With no futimes in sb-posix the time goes through the path the stream was opened on (the
fd-stream's file / name), used only while stat(path) has fstat(fd)'s device and inode; a file renamed, removed or
replaced since the open is NOT touched, counts as a failure (ENOENT) and is announced on stderr once
(docs/not-supported.md ns-utime-handle-path).  No new foreign call; a closed handle is EBADF; nothing is flushed first
(perl's futimes leaves the buffer, so a later flush moves the time on in both).
Probe scratch/s543n/probes/pI1.pl 10 rows: 8 = perl (the task's `1 20`, a glob, a glob ref, a mixed list, a closed
handle, buffered output then close, `utime undef, undef, $fh`); renamed / unlinked = the documented loud residue.
Guard Pl/t/fileio-02.t row 51 (FAILS on the base).
THE FULL FIX (a design, not shipped -- platform-touching): futimens(2) by sb-alien, `(sb-alien:alien-funcall
(sb-alien:extern-alien "futimens" (function sb-alien:int sb-alien:int (* (array timespec 2)))) fd times)` -- the same
spelling on Linux and macOS 10.13+ (`struct timespec { time_t tv_sec; long tv_nsec; }`, `UTIME_NOW` for undef times:
Linux ((1 << 30) - 1), macOS -1); it needs the install matrix and a macOS leg (the USER's rule).
FLAG: the shipped route uses only sb-posix stat / fstat / utime, already used on every platform; whether it still
counts as platform-touching is the reviewing session's call.
